response.overview: Bayu, a popular novelist, is haunted every night by mysterious cries—a sorrowful sound that keeps calling out to him for no apparent reason. Together with his daughter, Ima, he returns to his village in search of peace, but the sound only grows closer and begins to disrupt their lives. The cries turn into a call that leads Bayu to something that has long been hidden.
response.title: Sisigan Kariau: Sima
